summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing a declared distribution across six share classes: Class I-Series 1 at $0.3300, Class S at $0.2637, Class U at $0.2637, Class R at $0.3300, Class D at $0.3105 and Class F at $0.3300 per share. Holders of record as of September 30, 2026 receive payment on or about October 27, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium or change of control is implicated; the filing is an ordinary interval-fund distribution notice.
